verdicts.Box 1: A white robot with a dark visor stands behind a wooden cart with a glowing lantern and a bowl of food. The same box also gained a parked dark car and a pink-lit building. Outside the box the plaza matches the source.
verdicts.Box 2: The shopfronts inside the box were repainted with a new, garbled sign and potted plants. A small dark scooter is parked by a door. It is not red and has no visible ramen box.

otherAttempts: Earlier attempts while tuning this graph (P-Image Edit ignored the box; two sky-whale boxes came back empty; one run with a different photo missed box 1) are not shown. They are listed in the PR body with their costs.
